findings: Configuration parameter computation and register writes are distinct from input/output data movement. Sequential configurations add time; concurrent preparation changes the limiting stage and requires supporting hardware and dependence conditions.

accfg has setup/launch/await and a single live state per accelerator. Unknown calls constrain reordering; partial movement of impure setup is not implemented; accelerator faults are outside its model.
Gemmini evaluation uses Spike instruction traces, an assumed 3 cycles/instruction and Eq.3 as a performance proxy. It is not measured full model latency.
OpenGeMM uses a cycle-accurate Verilator model, 8×K×8 tiles, 1024 ops/cycle, and disables scratchpad data copies to isolate configuration. Geomean 2× is scoped to that experiment, not GPU serving.

numerical_discrepancy.recompute_policy: Use 2×64³ and exact counts: ideal compute 1024 cycles; minimal setup 1440 cycles; full setup 2805 cycles. Recomputed utilization is about 41.56% and 26.74%. Do not silently repair the archived paper or adopt its rounded percentages.

adoption.framework_gap: Compare with already archived vLLM/SGLang graph paths. The accfg paper is not evidence that those engines implement its passes; no new engine integration or release claim.
